learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to add rich, exciting details to your actions using adverbs that tell us exactly how, when, and where things happen!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: If verbs are the engine, adverbs are the turbo boost! An adverb is a word that describes a verb, an adjective, or even another adverb to give us more information.
These adverbs tell us exactly HOW an action is done. They usually end in '-ly'. For example, 'The turtle walked SLOWLY' or 'The child laughed HAPPILY'.
These adverbs tell us WHERE the action is taking place. Words like 'here', 'there', 'inside', 'outside', and 'everywhere' are all adverbs of place.

main_concepts.concept_title: ⏰ When and How Often? Time & Frequency
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Adverbs of Time tell us WHEN something happened (yesterday, now, later). Adverbs of Frequency tell us HOW OFTEN it happens (always, sometimes, never).

fun_activity.title: 🎬 The Silent Adverb Charades
fun_activity.instructions: Pick an action like 'eating' or 'walking'. Act it out for a friend using an Adverb of Manner (like clumsily, quickly, or sleepily) and see if they can guess the exact adverb!

quick_recap: ⭐ Adverbs are special words that modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs.
⭐ They help us answer important questions like How? (Manner), Where? (Place), When? (Time), and How often? (Frequency).
